ayahs.1: O you who have iman: Do not put yourselves ahead of Allah and His Messenger. Have taqwa of Allah. Allah hears and knows everything.
ayahs.2: O you who have iman: Do not raise your voices above the Prophet's voice, and do not speak to him loudly as you speak to one another, or your deeds may be wasted while you do not even notice.
ayahs.3: Those who lower their voices before Allah's Messenger are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. They will have forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.4: Most of those who call out to you from outside your private quarters lack proper understanding.
ayahs.5: Had they waited patiently until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. Allah is All-Forgiving, the Rahim.
ayahs.6: O you who have iman: If someone untrustworthy brings you news, verify it first, so you do not harm people in ignorance and then regret what you did.
ayahs.7: Know that Allah's Messenger is still among you. If he were to follow you in most matters, you would fall into hardship. But Allah has made iman beloved to you and adorned it in your hearts, and made denial, rebellion, and disobedience hateful to you. Those are the rightly guided.
ayahs.8: That is a favour and blessing from Allah. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
ayahs.9: If two groups of believers fight each other, make peace between them. If one group transgresses against the other, fight the transgressors until they submit to Allah's judgment. If they submit, make peace between them with justice. Allah loves those who act justly.
ayahs.10: The believers are one brotherhood. Make peace between your brothers. Have taqwa of Allah so you may receive mercy.
ayahs.11: O you who have iman: Let not some men ridicule other men—they may be better than them. Let not some women ridicule other women—they may be better than them. Do not insult one another or call each other by offensive nicknames. How wretched it is to return to rebellion after iman! Whoever does not repent—they are the wrongdoers.
ayahs.12: O you who have iman: Avoid much suspicion—some suspicion is sin. Do not spy on one another or backbite. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would loathe it. Have taqwa of Allah. Allah accepts repentance and is the Rahim.
ayahs.13: O humanity: We created you from one man and one woman, and made you into nations and tribes so you may know one another. The noblest among you in Allah's sight is the one with most taqwa. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Aware.
ayahs.14: Some desert Arabs say, 'We have iman.' Say: You do not yet have iman. Say rather, 'We have submitted,' for iman has not yet entered your hearts. If you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds. Allah is All-Forgiving, the Rahim.
ayahs.15: The true mu'min are only those who believe in Allah and His Messenger without doubt, and strive with their wealth and their lives in Allah's cause. They are the ones who are truthful in faith.
ayahs.16: Say: Would you inform Allah of your iman when Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth? Allah has knowledge of everything.
ayahs.17: They treat their becoming Muslim as a favour to you. Say: Do not count your Islam as a favour to me. It is Allah who favoured you by guiding you to iman—if you are truthful.
ayahs.18: Allah knows the unseen of the heavens and the earth. Allah sees everything you do.
